fields.summary: Minimum rest at home base: rule engine uses 10 h

content.text: Client request: reduce the minimum rest period before a duty starting at home base from 12 hours to 10 hours. The rule MinRestHomeBase reads the value from the parameter MIN_REST_HOME_BASE_HOURS.
Parameter MIN_REST_HOME_BASE_HOURS changed to 10 in the Example Air configuration.
The operations manual revision 4 still says 12 hours. Waiting for the client to publish an OM revision.
